findings.title: Pages reports terminal deployment failures without a server-side explanation
evidence: 40311358554 attempt 1: deployment 0c102c72e63ebd5d6232803c5b9019942fd55853 failed after creation at 2026-10-26T10:57:53Z.
Its attempt 2 stopped at Current main changed; no publication.
40321193513: deployment c598a7fcea1ad4fc741969e3a3ab9ff7c33b5039 went from deployment_queued to Deployment failed, try again later at 2026-10-26T12:16:45.9916831Z.
Both attempts passed the applicable complete-payload and rollback checks. The recovery also restored configure-pages, github-pages artifact naming and 600000ms timeouts.
findings.impact: COMMAND and the prepared static OPEN correction are not live. This is not evidence of a broken COMMAND application or a proven global/provider outage.
findings.smallestAction: Inspect the exact latest Pages deployment through the repaired read-only input. The remaining controlled compatibility option is official upload-pages-artifact packaging plus complete per-file read-back, if fresh active-state/rollback gates permit one attempt. Do not repeat the same artifact deployment blindly.
findings.verification: No further deployment or application retest in this audit. Packaging-versus-server/content cause remains unknown.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Publication job can expire during a valid rollback
evidence: Job timeout was 12 minutes; each deploy-pages call permits 10 minutes. Publication plus restoration can need over 20 minutes.
findings.impact: A slow successful publication followed by verification failure could exhaust the job before rollback finishes. Not the cause of the observed seconds-long failures.
findings.smallestAction: Allow 30 minutes for the bounded publication/restoration job. Preserve both action timeouts and no cancellation.
findings.verification: New release-safety check covers both 600000ms windows plus five minutes overhead.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Release compilation depends on accidental main history depth
evidence: fetch-depth:5 currently just reaches 2e3c45a6; another descendant commit pushes that accepted base outside the shallow checkout. cache-overlay default reads it with git show.
findings.impact: A future legitimate release can fail before publication despite unchanged application bytes.
findings.smallestAction: Check out the exact accepted base separately at depth 1 and use the existing validated baseRead seam. Current checkout also uses depth 1.
findings.verification: Actual workflow Node block executed in a fixture with no .git directory; the 21-file compiled manifest remains SHA-256 899151248c2fe2492f198ae19bc36a975287d0edad55cf5168c2657184e17ff1.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Known high-severity vulnerability in the build/test DOM dependency
evidence: npm audit identified happy-dom 20.14.5 in GHSA-834v-8h66-3h79; affected range 17.0.0–21.0.3; patched version 21.0.4.

The advisory requires JavaScript evaluation and attacker-controlled source. Main does not explicitly enable evaluation; exploitation is not demonstrated. This package is build/test tooling, not shipped browser runtime.
findings.impact: Latent host-code execution risk if unsafe evaluation is enabled in tooling.
findings.smallestAction: Pin patched happy-dom 21.0.4 and retain inert static rendering. No npm audit fix --force or unrelated dependency upgrades.
findings.verification: Node22.20.0; affected product SEO test PASS; four fictional generator output hashes unchanged; post-change npm audit reports 0 known vulnerabilities. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-834v-8h66-3h79
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Static-only and documentation pushes can perform unnecessary backend generation
evidence: CMS generation was unconditional although the static-only comment promised backend-free operation. generate-hub-cms calls public_hub_articles.
Ordinary documentation-only pushes previously selected the full generation workflow. Current main has no required branch status checks; that metadata was read before adding path exclusions.
findings.impact: Unnecessary build-time Supabase requests and avoidable deployment failures; actual byte consumption was not measured.
findings.smallestAction: Skip CMS only for static-only pushes, preserve cms-only/full/manual/scheduled behaviour, and ignore docs/Markdown-only push paths. Correct the stale 15-minute schedule comment to daily 03:00 UTC.
findings.verification: New workflow-condition matrix verifies full, static-only, cms-only, manual, scheduled and marked release paths.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Pure static renderers allow unnecessary asset loading by default
evidence: Product/commercial renderers constructed default Happy DOM Windows; CSS/iframe loading defaults were not disabled. These operations only edit markup.
findings.impact: Unnecessary resource-loading capability during generation; no claim that this caused measured production egress.
findings.smallestAction: Share a static-only Window factory with JavaScript evaluation and script/CSS/iframe loading disabled.
findings.verification: Loopback fixture received zero requests; inline script did not execute; four product/category/News fixture outputs stayed byte-identical.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Image-bearing full catalogue reads remain the production fallback
evidence: imageDeliveryConfig.enabled is false; default public repository includes image. readPublicRows uses response.json without row/response-size enforcement.
startProductDetail default refreshes the full catalogue before resolving the selected product.
Public cache expiry is 30 seconds. Visible public pages refresh two Operations/announcement RPCs at most once per minute, plus initial/visibility refreshes.
findings.impact: Plausible egress contributors, not attribution of the owner-reported 624.495 MB/day. Cache bounds are not wire-response bounds.
findings.smallestAction: Reuse accepted NIGHTFALL metadata/image delivery; verify its narrow live contract and activate separately. Preserve stock/checkout authority and existing cache invalidation; do not create a second optimisation programme.
findings.verification: Source paths/projections inspected. No live catalogue download or new Supabase request in this audit.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Accepted customer reliability corrections remain outside main
evidence: LANTERN/LIGHTHOUSE accepted startup containment is absent from main. SENTINEL fixes unavailable-basket intent loss, checkout focus/submission behaviour and settled contact Sending labels.
Main public sources remain identical to the previously assessed 2e3c45a6 source. LIGHTHOUSE 39981284222 and SENTINEL 39988495190 close their isolated browser gates.
findings.impact: Known failure-state defects persist; not evidence that normal checkout is down.
findings.smallestAction: Review outstanding interaction/copy decisions, then integrate the existing accepted deltas against a current complete payload. SENTINEL depends on the LANTERN/LIGHTHOUSE base. Do not redevelop them.
findings.verification: Existing source-specific native evidence reused; no screenshot download or browser suite repeated.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Two production publishing routes and a mission-specific release plan remain active
evidence: Legacy push/manual/daily generation still deploys; marked pushes/manual exact publication use a separate route.

The exact publisher pins old run/artifact identities, a five-deployment search window and one prior terminal failure. Later failures or expiry deliberately block it. This is not a reusable generic release service.
findings.impact: Confusing operator entry points and repeated recovery-specific edits. The original baseline artifact expiry is 27 October; retained corrected candidate/rollback expiry is 9 November.
findings.smallestAction: Keep one future production publisher for immutable complete artifacts; separate generator refresh from deployment. Retire legacy publishing only after the replacement and restoration actually succeed. Generalise receipts/deployment lookup with bounded proof; never silently ignore unknown failures.
findings.verification: All 17 registered workflow records and their latest executed definitions reviewed; no workflow removed or disabled.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: OPEN restoration receipt could falsely label the static state paused
evidence: preflight returned servedHoliday:ORDERS_PAUSED even when the restoration branch had verified an OPEN snapshot.
findings.impact: Misleading audit evidence, not an ordering-permission change.
findings.smallestAction: Report the parsed static state, retain the compatibility field and label it presentation-only.
findings.verification: New synthetic OPEN restoration receipt and strict main-drift rejection tests pass; backendRequests stays zero.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Pages inspection is hard-coded to an obsolete deployment
evidence: The diagnostic job selected 0c102c72... even after c598a7f failed. It required a specially marked main commit.
findings.impact: Inspecting the wrong deployment and creating unnecessary main commits.
findings.smallestAction: Offer an explicit read-only inspect operation with a validated deployment ID, no redirects, bounded output and read-only job permissions; exclude it from publication selection. Isolate nonpublishing runs from the pages queue.
findings.verification: New condition checks prove inspect cannot select the publication job; main/ref guards and serialized publishing remain.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Floating production Action refs and untracked local caches impair reproducibility
evidence: Legacy workflow used five moving Action tags; local Python bytecode and a node_modules symlink appeared as untracked files.
findings.impact: Avoidable source drift and review noise; no malicious Action or committed credential was found.
findings.smallestAction: Pin the already observed official action commits; ignore bytecode and root dependency symlinks.
findings.verification: Action-pin/credential-policy checks and git diff --check pass. No tracked file deleted.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed

findings.title: Main has no required branch checks; historical handovers contain superseded gates
evidence: Current branches/main metadata reports protected:false and no required checks. GitHub Pages environment restrictions are separate.
The frozen 54 acceptance report predates supplied metadata, current artifacts and explicit owner visual acceptance of df78c5bf. Its old PENDING flags are historical.
findings.impact: Do not treat either missing branch rules or old prose as current release authority.
findings.smallestAction: Keep dated evidence intact, use the reconciled register here, and consider required targeted checks as a separate owner-reviewed policy change. No protection settings changed.
findings.verification: Read-only repository metadata and existing acceptance records reconciled.
findings.productionEffect: No live change; integration not performed
